input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: § 22 meets the preferred position on every material term: audits are limited to once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, off-site where practicable, and by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (§ 22.1). § 22.2 places audit costs on Vendor unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding five percent, and expressly bars Vendor and its auditor from accessing Customer systems directly, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material or third-party confidential information — so there is no direct or remote system access. § 22.3 additionally protects us by making findings Customer Confidential Information and limiting their use. No other inspection or verification right binding us appears elsewhere in the document. No redline required.
